bio.text: Luz Rivas represents California's 29th Congressional District in the U.S. House, where her House website says she serves as the Freshman Leadership Representative for the 119th Congress.
She served six years in the California State Assembly before her election to Congress.
According to her House website, she worked as an electrical engineer for Motorola and founded DIY Girls, a nonprofit that encourages girls to pursue technology and engineering.
She grew up in Pacoima and graduated from San Fernando High School, earned a B.S. in electrical engineering from MIT, and holds a Master of Education degree from Harvard University.
